characterization_methods.key_findings: Primary phases remain ferrite and austenite; no observable new diffraction peak.
characterization_methods.purpose: Identify constituent phases after aging at 723 K for 3, 6, and 9 h.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Apollo 300 thermal field emission SEM equipped with EBSD detector
characterization_methods.key_findings: Ferrite content in 0.04Nb steel aged 723 K/9 h is 18.8 vol%; phase boundaries become irregular with bulges; NbC particle size increases with prolonged aging.
characterization_methods.purpose: Examine the microstructure and measure ferrite content in the 723 K/6 h and 9 h aged 0.04Nb steel.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: JEOL JEM-2100 TEM operating at 200 kV
characterization_methods.key_findings: After 9 h, κ-carbide volume fraction is 19.5 vol% and average size is 9 nm; SAED shows [100]γ // [100]κ coherent orientation relationship.
characterization_methods.purpose: Characterize intragranular κ-carbides in the 0.04Nb steel aged at 723 K for 6 and 9 h.
characterization_methods.technique: transmission electron microscopy (TEM) dark field and selected area electron diffraction (SAED)

characterization_methods.key_findings: Yield strength 1019 ± 3 MPa, tensile strength 1072 ± 3 MPa, total elongation 5 ± 1 %.
characterization_methods.purpose: Measure yield strength, tensile strength, and total elongation of the 723 K/9 h aged 0.04Nb steel.

analytical_models.model_note: Nb doping significantly increases the formation energy of κ-carbide.

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: 2×2×2 supercell of κ-carbide (Fe3AlC, E21); vacuum spacing 15 Å; 6×6×6 Monkhorst-Pack k-point sampling; two Nb substitution sites considered (Fe-site and Al-site)
computational_details.potential_model_or_database: PAW potentials; U = 2.59 eV for Fe atoms; kinetic energy cutoff 500 eV; Gaussian smearing width 0.05 eV
computational_details.simulation_method: spin-polarized density functional theory (DFT) within GGA-PBE

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: Fe-12Mn-9Al-1.4C-3Cr-xNb (wt%, x = 0–0.05) system; diffusion coefficients calculated over 673–873 K
computational_details.simulation_method: Thermo-Calc equilibrium phase diagram calculation and diffusion coefficient calculation

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Due to their small size, the nano-scale κ-carbides could be sheared by dislocations under plastic deformation.

interfaces.interface_notes: The phase boundaries between ferrite and austenite become irregular and feature numerous irregular bulges as the aging time prolongs.
interfaces.phase_evolution: Primary phases remain ferrite and austenite after aging at 723 K for 3, 6, and 9 h; no observable new diffraction peak in the XRD patterns.
interfaces.slip_behavior: Nano-scale κ-carbides could be sheared by dislocations under plastic deformation.

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: yield strength and total elongation at 723 K/9 h

processing_steps.method: centrifugal casting under near-rapid solidification (induction melting in water-cooled copper crucible, re-melting and pouring into rotating copper mold)
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Produces steel strips with dimensions 60 × 70 × 2.5 mm.
Extended aging at 723 K for 9 h was performed to study the effect of aging time on microstructure and mechanical properties.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Each steel strip underwent a minimum of four repetitions during testing.
measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: gauge width 4 mm, gauge length 12 mm

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: 0.04Nb steel aged at 723 K for 9 h fractures earliest, near 4% strain (Figure 13b).

samples.sample_label: 0.04Nb steel aged at 723 K for 9 h

phases_present.morphology: irregular-shaped ferrite islands; phase boundaries with austenite become irregular with numerous bulges as aging time prolongs

precipitates.distribution: submicron white particles within the austenite matrix

size.value: significantly increases with prolongation of the 723 K aging period (qualitative)

structures.overall_structure: Duplex microstructure of ferrite and austenite, with irregular ferrite dispersed in the austenite matrix, intragranular κ-carbides, and submicron NbC particles; no observable new diffraction peaks after aging at 723 K for 9 h.

unmapped_findings: The 0.04Nb steel aged at 723 K for 9 h shows a yield strength of 1019 ± 3 MPa but a low total elongation of 5 ± 1 %, indicating that extending the 723 K aging from 6 h to 9 h markedly reduces ductility.

Extended 723 K aging does not markedly alter the yield strength of the Nb-containing steels because κ-carbide precipitation strengthening intensifies while dislocation strengthening diminishes and grain-boundary strengthening remains relatively unchanged.
NbC particles in the 0.04Nb steel significantly increase in size with prolongation of the 723 K aging period (qualitative SEM observation; no 9 h numeric NbC size is reported).
